name: 2C-H
addictionPotential: No formal studies are reported. PsychonautWiki suggests it may be non-habit-forming based on psychedelics generally, while noting that its stimulant properties could still pose an addiction risk.
dosageRemark: Oral dosage and total duration are unknown, and no established dose data are available.
generalRisks: Recreational toxicity and long-term health effects have not been studied in a scientific context, and the exact toxic dose is unknown. Human-use history and pharmacological data are very limited.
saferUse: Harm-reduction practices and accurate measurement are advised. No dose is established.
metabolism: How the body breaks it down has not been established. PsychonautWiki summarizes a hypothesis that monoamine oxidase may break it down rapidly; this has not been confirmed in humans.
summary: 2C-H is a substituted phenethylamine and the simplest member of the 2C family. It is used mainly as a precursor to synthesize other 2C compounds; significant psychedelic activity has not been established.
